column8: Not a push-up, and not counted. On the video you sit up and crouch in front of the phone at the end of the set; the app was still counting and today refused it with "Go lower". Nothing in the counter changed: no reading I tried (torso angle, view) separates such moments from a real rep reliably yet, so they stay refused with words meant for a rep. The clip now runs 2:03.6–2:06.1 (it used to start at 1:50.5). "other" is the label for a moment that is not a push-up.
